<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check orange result
print(f"Orange click - Board changed: {last_action_result.get('board_changed')}, No impact: {last_action_result.get('no_impact')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
green_objects = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"\nGreen (N) objects: {len(green_objects)}")
for n in green_objects:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]

# Click first green object

    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    target_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    target_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
    print(f"\nClicking green at row={target_row}, col={target_col}")
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': target_row, 'col': target_col}])
</parameter>
</function>
